verses.en: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
verses.pt: Donde vêm as guerras e contendas entre vós? Porventura não vêm disto, dos vossos deleites, que nos vossos membros guerreiam?
verses.en_web: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
verses.en_bbe: What is the cause of wars and fighting among you? is it not in your desires which are at war in your bodies?

verses.en: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
verses.pt: Cobiçais e nada tendes; logo matais. Invejais, e não podeis alcançar; logo combateis e fazeis guerras. Nada tendes, porque não pedis.
verses.en_web: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
verses.en_bbe: You are burning with desire, and have not your desire, so you put men to death; you are full of envy, and you are not able to get your desire, so you are fighting and making war; you have not your desire, because you do not make request for it.

verses.en: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
verses.pt: Pedis e não recebeis, porque pedis mal, para o gastardes em vossos deleites.
verses.en_web: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
verses.en_bbe: You make your request but you do not get it, because your request has been wrongly made, desiring the thing only so that you may make use of it for your pleasure.

verses.en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
verses.pt: Infiéis, não sabeis que a amizade do mundo é inimizade contra Deus? Portanto qualquer que quiser ser amigo do mundo constitui-se inimigo de Deus.
verses.en_web: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
verses.en_bbe: O you who are false to God, do you not see that the friends of this world are not God's friends? Every man desiring to be a friend of this world makes himself a hater of God.

verses.en: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
verses.pt: Ou pensais que em vão diz a escritura: O Espírito que ele fez habitar em nós anseia por nós até o ciúme?
verses.en_web: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
verses.en_bbe: Or does it seem to you that it is for nothing that the holy Writings say, The spirit which God put into our hearts has a strong desire for us?

verses.en: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
verses.pt: Todavia, dá maior graça. Portanto diz: Deus resiste aos soberbos; dá, porém, graça aos humildes.
verses.en_web: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
verses.en_bbe: But he gives more grace. So that the Writings say, God is against the men of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low before him.

verses.en: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.pt: Sujeitai-vos, pois, a Deus; mas resisti ao Diabo, e ele fugirá de vós.
verses.en_web: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause be ruled by God; but make war on the Evil One and he will be put to flight before you.

verses.en: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
verses.pt: Chegai-vos para Deus, e ele se chegará para vós. Limpai as mãos, pecadores; e, vós de espírito vacilante, purificai os corações.
verses.en_web: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
verses.en_bbe: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Make your hands clean, you evil-doers; put away deceit from your hearts, you false in mind.

verses.en: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
verses.pt: Senti as vossas misérias, lamentai e chorai; torne-se o vosso riso em pranto, e a vossa alegria em tristeza.
verses.en_web: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
verses.en_bbe: Be troubled, with sorrow and weeping; let your laughing be turned to sorrow and your joy to grief.

verses.en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.pt: Humilhai-vos perante o Senhor, e ele vos exaltará.
verses.en_web: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
verses.en_bbe: Make yourselves low in the eyes of the Lord and you will be lifted up by him.

verses.en: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.pt: Irmãos, não faleis mal uns dos outros. Quem fala mal de um irmão, e julga a seu irmão, fala mal da lei, e julga a lei; ora, se julgas a lei, não és observador da lei, mas juiz.
verses.en_web: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.en_bbe: Do not say evil against one another, my brothers. He who says evil against his brother or makes himself his brother's judge, says evil against the law and is judging the law: and in judging the law you become, not a doer of the law but a judge.

verses.en: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
verses.pt: Há um só legislador e juiz, aquele que pode salvar e destruir; tu, porém, quem és, que julgas ao próximo?
verses.en_web: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
verses.en_bbe: There is only one judge and law-giver, even he who has the power of salvation and of destruction; but who are you to be your neighbour's judge?

verses.en: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
verses.pt: Eia agora, vós que dizeis: Hoje ou amanhã iremos a tal cidade, lá passaremos um ano, negociaremos e ganharemos.
verses.en_web: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
verses.en_bbe: How foolish it is to say, Today or tomorrow we will go into this town, and be there for a year and do business there and get wealth:

verses.en: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
verses.pt: No entanto, não sabeis o que sucederá amanhã. Que é a vossa vida? Sois um vapor que aparece por um pouco, e logo se desvanece.
verses.en_web: Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.
verses.en_bbe: When you are not certain what will take place tomorrow. What is your life? It is a mist, which is seen for a little time and then is gone.

verses.en: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
verses.pt: Em lugar disso, devíeis dizer: Se o Senhor quiser, viveremos e faremos isto ou aquilo.
verses.en_web: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
verses.en_bbe: But the right thing to say would be, If it is the Lord's pleasure and if we are still living, we will do this and that.

verses.en: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
verses.pt: Mas agora vos jactais das vossas presunções; toda jactância tal como esta é maligna.
verses.en_web: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
verses.en_bbe: But now you go on glorying in your pride: and all such glorying is evil.

verses.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
verses.pt: Aquele, pois, que sabe fazer o bem e não o faz, comete pecado.
verses.en_web: To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
verses.en_bbe: The man who has knowledge of how to do good and does not do it, to him it is sin.
